Tests that CommandLineAPIScope uses HasRealNamedProperty and does not trigger a Proxy has trap on globalThis.
{
    id : <messageId>
    result : {
        result : {
            description : 2
            type : number
            value : 2
        }
    }
}
{
    id : <messageId>
    result : {
        result : {
            type : object
            value : {
                globalDebugType : undefined
                leakedDebugType : undefined
                sideEffectTriggered : false
            }
        }
    }
}
